name: Azure Storage Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of Azure Storage Account configurations. Covers blob containers, file shares, queues, tables, access keys, shared access signatures (SAS), storage firewalls, encryption, and data exposure risks in Azure storage services.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to Azure Storage security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands Azure Storage services and their access control mechanisms
evidence: Can explain storage account types, blob containers, and access tiers
Understands access keys, SAS tokens, and Entra ID-based access
Familiar with common Azure Storage data exposure patterns

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Enumerates and reviews Azure Storage configurations under supervision
evidence: Uses tools to scan for publicly accessible storage containers
Reviews storage account network rules and access configurations under guidance
Documents Azure Storage security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses Azure Storage security posture across subscriptions
evidence: Independently identifies misconfigured storage account access policies and SAS tokens
Evaluates storage firewall rules and private endpoint configurations
Produces compliant Azure Storage assessment reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex storage security scenarios including cross-tenant access and data flow analysis
evidence: Identifies data exposure through SAS token abuse and cross-subscription access
Develops automated Azure Storage audit tooling
Reviews storage assessment work of junior analysts
Assesses storage-backed application architectures for data leakage

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab Azure Storage assessment methodology; discovers novel storage attack vectors
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's Azure Storage security assessment methodology
Published research on Azure Storage bypass techniques or data exfiltration
Trains teams on advanced Azure Storage security assessment

assessment_methods.description: Assess a multi-subscription Azure environment with intentional storage misconfigurations and identify all data exposure risks
Review Azure Storage security findings from recent cloud assessment engagements

cis: CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark v5.0.0 - Section 9 Storage Services
